title: Over-the-Counter Allowance — Program Terms for PrairieRx Members
content:
**Terms of the Pharmacy Benefit over-the-counter (OTC) allowance.**

### Terms in force

1. **Spending.** The OTC allowance is spent only on catalog items through the channels of the member's PrairieRx plan. A purchase never exceeds the allowance balance, and the member pays the difference at the register.
2. **Order limit.** Mail catalog and online orders are limited to the plan's number of mail catalog and online orders per quarter. The count is the purchases on the member's coverage in the calendar quarter of the order whose channel is mail catalog or online. Retail purchases are not limited in number.
3. **Coverage status.** The allowance is loaded and spent only on a coverage in active or restricted status, as the system record of the member's pharmacy coverage shows before the load or purchase.

### Retired terms

The following clauses are **no longer in force**:

- *"The OTC allowance is loaded on the first day of each calendar quarter."* Loading of a quarter's allowance is now governed by the current quarter-load basis of the Pharmacy Benefit.
- *"Unused allowance is forfeited on the last day of the quarter or on the coverage end date, whichever comes first, and never rolls over where the plan's rollover setting is No."* Under that clause the amount forfeited was the allowance balance. The treatment of a closed quarter's unused allowance is now governed by the current closed-quarter basis of the Pharmacy Benefit.

The plan figures for the quarterly allowance, the rollover setting, the channels and the orders per quarter remain the plan's figures.

### Purchase examples (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical purchase | Allowance balance | Charged to the allowance | Paid by the member at the register |
|---|---|---|---|
| Catalog items of $18.00 | $25.00 | $18.00 | $0.00 |
| Catalog items of $31.40 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $6.40 |

| Plan orders per quarter (hypothetical) | Mail catalog or online orders already in the quarter | Another mail catalog or online order |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Within the limit |
| 1 | 1 | Beyond the limit |
| 1 | 1, plus any number of retail purchases | Beyond the limit; retail purchases do not count |
